bio: Treat yourself with a trip to Thornton Hall Hotel and Spa where you will find the perfect place to enjoy 'The Great Wirral Afternoon Tea'. Enjoy Tea in the lounge area of the lawns or, if weather permits, in the glorious grounds surrounding the hotel.  Afternoon Tea includes a selection of finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and preserves and an assortment of sweets as well as a wide variety of loose leef teas to suit every mood, including exotic mandarin rose petal.  Conveniently located for Merseyside, Manchester, Cheshire and North Wales, Thornton Hall Hotel in the Wirral is placed in glorious grounds. Thornton Hall Hotel is easily accesible from either Heswall or Neston railway stations.
